selection.description: Seven nearby named galaxy clusters, independently selected from MCXC-II. Centres and R500 apertures only; no synthetic members or density model.
selection.distanceCaveat: Comoving positions derived from spectroscopic redshifts using the MCXC-II flat cosmology (H0=70 km/s/Mpc, Omega_m=0.3). No peculiar-velocity correction or redshift-independent local distance is claimed; this matters especially for nearby Virgo and Fornax.
